headline: New acceptance tests for watches across router backends and modes
reason: New test-only file; it cannot affect production behavior and adds coverage for the watch changes elsewhere in the PR.
summary: Adds pkg/router/watch_test.go, which runs watches through forward, aggregate, single-tenant and in-process backends in standalone and middleware modes. It checks streaming, watch-list parameters, timeoutSeconds, client disconnect, half-open breaker release, watch metrics, backend replacement, service stop and upgrade rejection. A short skim is enough because it is new test code and changes no production path.
